description: This file defines a final class 'ModelEvents' containing constants for various model-related events in the Goteo framework, such as create, update, and delete actions, along with their corresponding event names used in the event system.

classes.name: Goteo\Core\ModelEvents
classes.description: A final class encapsulating event name constants for model lifecycle events in the Goteo application.

methods.name: const CREATE
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.create' event triggered before a model is inserted into the database.

methods.name: const CREATED
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.created' event triggered after a model has been inserted into the database.

methods.name: const UPDATE
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.update' event triggered before a model is updated in the database.

methods.name: const UPDATED
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.updated' event triggered after a model has been updated.

methods.name: const DELETE
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.delete' event triggered before a model is deleted.

methods.name: const DELETED
methods.description: Constant for the 'model.deleted' event triggered after a model has been deleted.
